MASTER MOTION CALENDAR ON MAR-22-2018 IN 206, DEFENDANT CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF TAX AND FEE ADMINISTRATION'S UNOPPOSED MOTION TO CONTINUE TRIAL DATE. DUE TO AN EMERGENCY, JUDGE JACKSON WAS NOT PRESENT BUT ISSUED HER TENTATIVE RULING THROUGH THE CALENDAR COORDINATOR. THE TENTATIVE RULING IS AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF TAX AND FEE ADMINISTRATION'S MOTION TO CONTINUE TRIAL IS GRANTED PURSUANT TO STIPULATION. THERE BEING NO OBJECTION TO THE TENTATIVE RULING, MOVING PARTY SUBMITS A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. THE TRIAL DATE OF 6/11/18 IS CONTINUED TO 3/11/19 AT 9:30AM IN DEPT. 206 PER PARTIES' STIPULATION. ALL DATES SHALL TRACK THE NEW TRIAL DATE. HEATHER B. HOESTEREY, ESQ. APPEARING FOR DEFENDANT. NO OTHER APPEARANCES ON THIS MATTER. (206)
